description: The WIKI's CHANGES across pages, newest first: who made, edited, renamed, restored a version of, moved, deleted (to the trash), brought back from the trash, archived or returned which page, and who commented on it. Each row: 'type' (created, edited, edited_minor, renamed, restored, page_moved, page_moved_space, page_deleted, page_restored, page_archived, page_unarchived, page_commented, page_comment_updated, page_comment_deleted), 'at', 'actor' / 'actorUsername', 'via' (the door: ui, api, mcp, agent, system, voice), the page — 'pageId', 'title' and 'spaceKey' as they are today, 'status' current / archived / trashed — and its facts: 'version' (the version a text change wrote — or a move, which writes one of its own; read it, or what changed against the version before, with get_wiki_page and its version), 'subject' / 'detail' (a rename's new and old title, a move's new and old parent or space — a parent you may not open is null; a restore's source version is 'detail'), 'note' (the edit's message), 'changeSummary' (what a text change changed, in a line or two in the page's language — written once, shortly after the edit, by a rule for a small one and by a model otherwise; null while it is being written, where the company has no AI or switched it off, and on every other row), 'commentId', 'agent'. Only pages you may open are in it: page restrictions, groups, pages opened to you and the projects you are on all count, as they do when you read the page. Filters together: 'space' (a space or project key), 'user' (username, e-mail or display name), 'from' / 'to' (days like 2026-11-01, both inclusive, or ISO moments), 'pageId' with 'subtree' for one page and every page under it. 'before' is the 'next' of the previous call, to read further back. For one page's whole history — approvals, reading, reviews, files — see get_wiki_page_history.

before.description: The 'next' the previous call answered, to read further back. Omit for the newest.

from.description: From this day (2026-11-01) or moment, inclusive.

pageId.description: Only this page (id, as search_wiki returns it).

space.description: A space's key — the project's key, e.g. 'PM'. Omit for every space you may read.

subtree.description: With pageId: the page and every page under it.

to.description: Up to this day (inclusive, the whole day) or moment (exclusive).

user.description: Only changes by this person: username, e-mail or display name.

name: list_wiki_changes
